open_candidates_checked_against_codebase.description: Role: Measures a hand-built golden room once per biome: platform/gap spacing and reachability (jump/wall-jump/dodge, live-queried against the character CDO, never hardcoded), plus 2D sprite scale and HSV color-value consistency across placed instances. [UPDATED v4] Also ingests the GDD (Death_Metal_Cat_GDD_v3.docx) once, extracts room roles and the agent roster, and halts before measuring anything if the GDD's documented movement-constant categories don't reconcile with a live-vs-C++-header-default comparison beyond a 1% relative tolerance — this caught and led to fixing a real 9.1% JumpZVelocity drift between the live-tuned Blueprint and the stale C++ header default.. Input: Golden room level asset, GDD (read once, passed downstream as structured data). Output: biome_spec_<Biome>.json, gdd_reference.json

open_candidates_checked_against_codebase.stated_status: [UPDATED v4] Proven — built, and validated three ways (cross-check against Foundation Extractor's own output on Room1, a synthetic too-wide-gap test, and real runs against Room1/Room2) (commit e64dba1)
open_candidates_checked_against_codebase.description: Role: Independently re-checks every gap in a room against biome_spec.json's measured movement constants — the deterministic (non-LLM) validation pass. compute_gaps() is extracted as a single shared function so Foundation Extractor and Reachability Verifier can never drift out of sync with each other.. Input: Room's live platform actors, biome_spec.json. Output: Pass/fail per gap + flagged issues

open_candidates_checked_against_codebase.section: 4.2 Agent Roster — Technical Detail (Pillar 1 — AI Dev Pipeline)
open_candidates_checked_against_codebase.stated_status: [UPDATED v4] Proven — built, reuses compute_gaps() and a newly-extracted compute_derived_movement_constants() as shared math with Foundation Extractor; validated against Room1 (source-room baseline), Room2 (fresh recompute), and Room3 (clean status-gate skip) (commit 187f856)
open_candidates_checked_against_codebase.description: Role: Answers two questions Reachability Verifier's binary pass/fail doesn't: whether a room's PASS is still trustworthy if movement constants have drifted since biome_spec.json was generated, and whether a technically-reachable gap is comfortable or needs manual playtest confirmation (tight-margin flag, ≥85% of max range — the OneWayPlatform11→15 lesson: formula-reachable isn't automatically playtest-trustworthy). Gated by Tools/room_status.json (nested per biome, three states: not_started / in_progress / finished) so an unfinished room is cleanly skipped rather than falsely flagged as failing.. Input: Room's live state, biome_spec.json, gdd_reference.json, room_status.json. Output: stress_test_<Room>.json: drift findings + comfortable_pass / tight_pass_needs_playtest / fail per gap
